help.icalPageTitle: How to connect your calendar via iCal
help.icalPageDescription: Step-by-step instructions to export the iCal URL from the most popular platforms. Copy the link and paste it in the calendar sync page.
help.icalIntro: Each platform calls it differently: "Export calendar", "Sync calendars", "Secret iCal address". Find yours below and paste the URL in the connection dialog.
help.icalTooltipText: Don't know where to find your iCal link? See how to export it from Airbnb, Booking, Google Calendar and other platforms.
airbnbSteps: Go to Menu → Listings and select your listing
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
bookingSteps: Copy the iCal URL shown in the popup
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
vrboSteps: Go to Dashboard → select your property
Click Export → copy the iCal URL
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
googleCalendarSteps: On a computer: open Google Calendar
On the left, click the calendar name
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
appleCalendarSteps: Right-click a calendar in the sidebar
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
outlookSteps: Select the calendar and permission level
Paste it in the CasaZen iCal dialog
help.syncFrequencyNote: CasaZen syncs iCal feeds every 15 minutes. Changes made on the external calendar will appear within 15 minutes.
